prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original low-magic medieval RPG pixel-art character review board, TWO ROWS by TWO COLUMNS. Each row depicts the SAME adult character front three-quarter and rear three-quarter, all four full bodies isolated with generous spacing on uniform neutral grey. Top PELAN, adult woman tenant who wants her lived years recognized but may choose to leave: short dark curled hair, muted moss-green patched wool tunic dress over brown underskirt, practical boots, plain small shoulder bag, carries a small removed wooden tenancy plaque with rubbed blank surface, cautious determined posture. Bottom MALER, older male landlord who genuinely repairs the old building but exploits accounting: stocky grey-haired man with trimmed beard, dull plum-brown wool waistcoat over tan shirt, leather work belt and small carpentry mallet, two ordinary keys resting at belt, reserved self-justifying stance. Distinct believable silhouettes, nobody royal or monstrous. These are proposed appearances only, NOT canonical detail. Do not depict exchanged keys, eviction, settlement, signature, moving house or reconciliation; separate neutral pose studies do not choose quest route. Hard chunky readable pixel clusters, compact top-down-oblique medieval game character proportions, selectively dark outline, earthy wool/leather colors and limited cloth folds; prefer simple faces over portrait detail. No text, numbers, symbols, labels, glossy smooth shading, gradients, magic, scenery or decorative border. Review concept, native pixel-grid/palette/anchor/runtime not certified.
